evidence.title: NEXTDC 1H26 Results Presentation
evidence.excerpt: NEXTDC reports 272.9 MW of in-progress mechanical and electrical data-hall fit-out across 12 named facilities and reports early or preliminary works underway at S4 Sydney and TK1 Tokyo.

metadata.reporting_date_scope: The 12 in-progress facility values and portfolio totals on PDF page 16 are reported as at 31 December 2025.
metadata.in_progress_definition_as_reported: Mechanical and electrical fit-out underway to prepare data halls for customer deployments.

metadata.fit_out_metric_scope: The table is headed by Total IT power (MW), defines in progress as mechanical and electrical fit-out to prepare data halls, and reports the 12 named incremental values. Each normalized row is therefore planned project critical_it_mw for only that incremental fit-out.
metadata.fit_out_double_count_guardrail: Each in-progress amount is nested within its facility's built-plus-in-progress or whole-facility total. Built, operational, initial, and whole-facility values remain evidence metadata only and create no additional capacity rows; the incremental values are not current load, measured consumption, operational capacity, or amounts additive to whole-facility totals.
metadata.facility_status_guardrail: Facility-card labels such as Operational and practical-completion forecasts remain metadata. They do not change the 12 source-scoped incremental fit-out projects from mep_electrical, and they create no operational or commissioning lifecycle rows.
metadata.s4_early_works_wording_as_reported: S4 Sydney early works in progress
metadata.early_works_capacity_guardrail: S4's approximately 350 MW and TK1's approximately 30 MW are total-power plans whose metric is not identified as critical IT, gross facility demand, grid connection, generation, current load, or annual energy. They remain untyped evidence metadata and create no capacity rows.
metadata.excluded_future_or_planning_scope: M4 and S5 future early works, AK1 planning activities, and S7 design, planning, or fast-track status are excluded because the capture does not establish current physical construction for those projects.
metadata.classification_guardrail: References to customers, customer deployments, enterprise, ICT, cloud, hyperscale, neocloud, AI, cable landing stations, or network infrastructure do not establish a tenant, customer, normalized operating model, or actual workload for any facility.
metadata.location_guardrail: Facility codes and named cities or regions support only authoritative locality strings. They do not establish street addresses, parcels, coordinates, footprints, geometries, or unique-site counts.
metadata.metric_exclusion_guardrail: No PUE, annual energy, grid-connection capacity, gross-facility capacity, generation nameplate, current load, operational capacity, or measured consumption row is imported.
metadata.imagery_guardrail: No satellite imagery, computer vision, or analyst geolocation contributes to identity, locality, lifecycle, capacity, or classification.
metadata.role_guardrail: NEXTDC's publication and named counterparties or customer groups are not normalized into owner, operator, developer, tenant, customer, utility, contractor, investor, or other roles.
metadata.rights_scope: Compact factual extraction under the publisher's all-rights-reserved terms; the captured PDF is not redistributed.
